newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: DCP still in market for own stock.
newsitem.headline: DCP still in market for own stock.

text.p: Direct Capital Partners said on Monday it was still in the market to buy back its own shares at or below NZ$0.75 per share.
In June 1996 the directors said the company was entering the market to buy back up to 2.5 million of the ordinary shares at prices of up to NZ$0.75 per share.
The company had to date acquired 2.185 million ordinary shares at an average price of NZ$0.71, representing about 3.0 percent of the shares on issue.
The shares were being held as treasury stock.
"The company is still in the market where the shares trade at or below NZ$0.75 as values below this are at inappropriately high discounts to asset backing," DCP said.
